seasons.title: ICAR news: onion variety Bhima Red (source: ICAR-DOGR, Pune)
seasons.quote: for rabi in Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra
seasons.note: Variety Bhima Red; rabi is the main onion season in Madhya Pradesh.

days_to_first_harvest.title: ICAR news: onion variety Bhima Red (source: ICAR-DOGR, Pune)
days_to_first_harvest.quote: in 110-120 days after transplanting in late kharif and rabi seasons
days_to_first_harvest.note: Time to maturity of one variety (Bhima Red); onion is harvested once, so the bulb is ready 110 days after transplanting.

harvest_span_days.title: ICAR news: onion variety Bhima Red (source: ICAR-DOGR, Pune)
harvest_span_days.quote: in 110-120 days after transplanting in late kharif and rabi seasons
harvest_span_days.note: 120 - 110 = 10 days in which the bulbs mature (single harvest).

sun.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (climate)
sun.quote: Open sunlight is essential for good yield

water_need.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (aftercultivation)
water_need.quote: Need based irrigation must be given.
water_need.note: Interpreted: the source recommends regular irrigation every few days in summer; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (climate)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: The crop will not tolerate water logging.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The crop yields about 15 – 18 t/ha in 140 – 150 days.

source_notes: AI research batch 2 (2026-10-05). Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are missing: the ICAR-DOGR site (dogr.icar.gov.in) could not be opened from the research machine, so its season pages were not verified.

sow_windows.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (climate)
sow_windows.quote: Onion can be successfully cultivated in mid lands of Kerala during October - November.
sow_windows.note: Planting months; ICAR gives rabi as the main onion season in Madhya Pradesh.
